name: ingest-study-guide
description: Book 5 path 2b: the BJCP Beer Style Study Guide scoped to option B — only History and Techniques passages reach kb.chunks. Every other labelled field restates an already-populated ref.styles column and is dropped (plan 05 §2b).

parameters.query:
WITH d AS (
  INSERT INTO kb.documents (slug, title, doc_type, language, authority)
  VALUES ($2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
  ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE SET
    title = EXCLUDED.title, doc_type = EXCLUDED.doc_type,
    language = EXCLUDED.language, authority = EXCLUDED.authority
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO kb.document_versions
  (document_id, version, source_filename, file_sha256, chunker_config, is_current)
SELECT d.id,
       COALESCE((SELECT max(v.version) FROM kb.document_versions v
                 WHERE v.document_id = d.id), 0) + 1,
       'sg_passages.json', $1,
       jsonb_build_object('source','structured','generator','sg-passage',
                          'extractor','scripts/ingest/sg_extract.py',
                          'scope','option B: History + Techniques only',
                          'dropped', jsonb_build_array('Overall Impression','Comments',
                                       'Ingredients','Commercial Examples','sensory tables')),
       false
FROM d
ON CONFLICT (file_sha256) DO UPDATE
  SET chunker_config = EXCLUDED.chunker_config
RETURNING id AS version_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ (() => { const p = $('Doc variant').first().json; return [ $('Crypto').first().json.file_sha256, p.slug, p.title, p.doc_type, p.language, p.authority]; })() }}

parameters.query:
WITH demoted AS (
  UPDATE kb.document_versions SET is_current = false
  WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id
)
DELETE FROM kb.chunks
WHERE version_id = (SELECT id FROM demoted)
RETURNING chunk_index;

SELECT c.id, c.content
FROM kb.chunks c
WHERE c.version_id = $1
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb.chunk_embeddings e
                  WHERE e.chunk_id = c.id AND e.model = 'bge-m3')
ORDER BY c.chunk_index;

INSERT INTO kb.chunk_embeddings (chunk_id, model, embedding)
VALUES ($1, 'bge-m3', $2::vector)
ON CONFLICT (chunk_id, model) DO UPDATE
  SET embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding, created_at = now()
RETURNING chunk_id, (xmax = 0) AS inserted;

INSERT INTO kb.ingest_log (version_id, stage, level, message, detail)
VALUES
  ($1::bigint, 'parse', 'info',
   format('scoped %s passages from the Study Guide: %s History, %s Techniques, %s words across %s styles',
          $2::jsonb->>'passages', $2::jsonb->>'history', $2::jsonb->>'techniques',
          $2::jsonb->>'words', $2::jsonb->>'styles'),
   jsonb_build_object('stats', $2::jsonb,
                      'scope', 'option B: History + Techniques only',
                      'dropped', jsonb_build_array('Overall Impression','Comments',
                                   'Ingredients','Commercial Examples','sensory tables')))
RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Ensure KB doc + version').first().json.version_id, JSON.stringify($('Parse + validate passages').first().json.stats)] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO kb.chunks
  (version_id, chunk_index, content, raw_content, heading_path,
   page_from, page_to, token_count, content_sha256)
SELECT $1::bigint,
       x.ord::int,
       array_to_string(ARRAY['BJCP Study Guide', x.style, x.field], ' > ') || E'\n' || x.text,
       x.text,
       ARRAY['BJCP Study Guide', x.style, x.field],
       NULL::int, NULL::int, NULL::int,
       encode(sha256(convert_to(x.text, 'UTF8')), 'hex')
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS x(ord int, style text, field text, text text)
ON CONFLICT (version_id, chunk_index) DO UPDATE SET
  content        = EXCLUDED.content,
  raw_content    = EXCLUDED.raw_content,
  heading_path   = EXCLUDED.heading_path,
  content_sha256 = EXCLUDED.content_sha256;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Ensure KB doc + version').first().json.version_id, JSON.stringify($('Parse + validate passages').first().json.rows)] }}
